note: In-source base capability library (version-controlled). The CapabilityRegistry merges the external distilled library over this base when present; this base guarantees the gates run standalone with no external library.

capabilities.applicability: Any physics research task that positions a claim relative to prior work.
capabilities.basic_criteria: Retrieve >= 8 DIRECT prior works on the specific problem (not just reviews or textbooks).
capabilities.advanced_criteria: Prioritise the closest competitors and the works whose claims most overlap with the intended contribution.
hard_fail: Fewer than 8 direct prior works identified

capabilities.applicability: Whenever prior work must be compared substantively, not just cited.
capabilities.basic_criteria: Read the main text (Introduction, Model/Methods, Results, Discussion) of >= 6 direct prior works; mark ABSTRACT_ONLY / FULLTEXT_UNAVAILABLE honestly.
capabilities.advanced_criteria: Extract each paper's method, main results, and stated limits well enough to compare quantitatively.
capabilities.pass_threshold: >= 6 papers with FULLTEXT_READ and real sections_read

capabilities.applicability: Positioning the current work against each closest prior work.
capabilities.basic_criteria: For every prior work record its overlap with, and difference from, the current work, and the implication for the current claims.
capabilities.advanced_criteria: State what each paper did and did NOT solve, and any new opportunity it suggests for the current work.
hard_fail: A prior-work row is missing overlap / difference / claim-implication analysis
capabilities.pass_threshold: 100% of prior-work rows have overlap, difference, and claim implication

capabilities.applicability: Any headline claim of novelty, mechanism, or result.
capabilities.basic_criteria: Map every headline claim to its closest prior work; never claim 'nobody has done this' without a documented search.
capabilities.advanced_criteria: Decide, per claim, whether a downgrade is needed given the closest prior work.
hard_fail: A headline claim has no closest prior work identified
capabilities.pass_threshold: every headline claim maps to a closest prior work

capabilities.applicability: Recording how deeply each source was actually read.
capabilities.basic_criteria: fulltext_status is one of FULLTEXT_READ / ABSTRACT_ONLY / FULLTEXT_UNAVAILABLE and is consistent with sections_read and evidence_quote_or_location.
capabilities.advanced_criteria: Anchor each substantive comparison to a quote or precise location in the source.
hard_fail: search too thin yet 'nobody has done this' asserted
